task: Fix Text Hint Blocking Sequential Sends with Audio
summary: Successfully fixed blocking issue where text hints with audio prevented sequential sends, and implemented 3-second auto-dismiss for text hints.

root_causes.description: Text hint audio had onFinish={() => {}} which never called clearMedia(), preventing state cleanup
Text hints remained visible indefinitely, never clearing themselves automatically
Text hints and their background audio shared the same state (currentMedia), creating blocking dependencies

symptoms: Text hint sent with audio plays once
Sending another text hint immediately doesn't work
Text hints stay pulsing forever instead of auto-dismissing after 3 seconds
currentMedia state never cleared, blocking new media

solution_implemented.approach: Separate State Management for Text Hints and Background Audio
solution_implemented.rationale: Decoupling text display lifecycle from audio playback lifecycle allows independent management and prevents blocking

changes.description: Added separate state variables for text hints and background audio
variables: textHintDisplay: RoomDisplayMediaEvent | null - stores active text hint
backgroundAudio: string | null - stores background audio URL
textHintTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null - manages 3-second auto-dismiss

changes.description: Modified room-display:media event handler to route text hints separately
logic: If mediaType === 'text': use textHintDisplay state + set timer
If mediaType !== 'text': use currentMedia state (existing flow)
Clear any existing text hint timer before starting new one

behavior: Timer starts when text hint is displayed
After 3 seconds, emits 'finished' status and clears textHintDisplay
Timer is cancelled and restarted if new text hint arrives before 3 seconds
Timer is cleared on component destroy to prevent memory leaks

changes.description: Separated text hint rendering from regular media rendering
structure: Text hints: rendered from textHintDisplay state (auto-dismiss after 3s)
Background audio: rendered from backgroundAudio state (plays independently)
Regular media: rendered from currentMedia state (existing behavior)

changes: Added textHintDisplay, backgroundAudio, textHintTimer state variables
Modified room-display:media event handler to separate text hints from regular media
Implemented 3-second auto-dismiss timer for text hints
Updated onDestroy to clean up timer
Restructured template to render text hints and background audio separately
Removed empty onFinish callback that was blocking clearMedia()

svelte_check.note: 7 pre-existing errors found in other files (not related to this change)

logic_verification.expected: New text hint immediately replaces old one
logic_verification.implementation: textHintDisplay = event clears previous text, timer is reset

logic_verification.expected: Audio plays full duration even if text disappears
logic_verification.implementation: backgroundAudio state separate from textHintDisplay, cleared by onFinish

logic_verification.expected: playing status when displayed, finished status after 3 seconds
logic_verification.implementation: emitPlaybackStatus called on display and in timer callback

logic_verification.expected: Audio, video, image continue to work normally
logic_verification.implementation: currentMedia state and clearMedia() function unchanged for non-text media

criteria_2.requirement: Sending another text hint immediately replaces the previous one
criteria_2.evidence: textHintDisplay = event overwrites previous value, timer is reset

criteria_3.requirement: Background audio plays without blocking text display

criteria_4.requirement: Audio plays for full duration even if text disappears
criteria_4.evidence: backgroundAudio only cleared by RoomAudio onFinish callback

criteria_5.evidence: currentMedia state and clearMedia() unchanged for non-text types

scenario_2_sequential_text_hints: 1. First text hint displayed, timer starts
2. After 1 second, second text hint arrives
3. First timer cleared, first text replaced immediately
4. Second text displayed, new 3-second timer starts
6. Second audio starts (overlaps with first if timing allows)
scenario_3_text_then_regular_media: 6. Regular media continues until autoDismiss or user action

technical_notes.timer_safety: Timer cleared in onDestroy to prevent memory leaks on component unmount
technical_notes.race_condition_handling: Timer callback checks sessionId and triggeredAt to ensure it only clears the correct text hint
technical_notes.backward_compatibility: Regular media flow completely unchanged, no breaking changes
technical_notes.audio_overlap: Multiple text hints sent quickly may overlap audio - this is expected behavior
